sourceVitestConfigDifferencesFromCapsule: Use original installed Vitest4.1.11 with Node24.19.0; no installation or original-tree writes.

Minimal node config includes only the declared test extension (.test.ts or .test.mjs); omits renderer aliases, feature-wall define, DOM/host-port setup, execArgv and original extended timeouts. Reviewed closure does not depend on those facilities. No full-config or typecheck equivalence claimed.
isolationRationale: Real temporary marker files. Electron app is mocked; fs read passes through except simulated EACCES. process.resourcesPath is replaced in the test process and restored; no Electron launch, updater or network.
testEvidenceBoundary: Reader state and cache only; no real update entrypoint or packed application. formatVersion accepts any number; forward version policy beyond that is not asserted.
